name: Phota Labs
summary: Identity-preserving photo generation, editing, enhancement and restyling from trained person profiles (Phota API).

api_key.description: A Phota API key from the Developer Portal (platform.photalabs.com). Sent in the X-API-Key header.

notes: Identity is preserved only for profiles you pass: reference them in the prompt as [[profile_id]] and, on edit/enhance/remix, list them in profile_ids. Profiles are trained once from 5-50 photos of the person.
Billed per output image from the account's credit balance; the with-identity rate applies when a trained profile is recognized in the output (e.g. nb2 1K: $0.08 base, $0.10 with identity).

Image calls answer synchronously with base64 images by default (response_mode bytes). Set response_mode urls for signed URLs (24-hour expiry). With async true (which requires response_mode urls) the call returns 202 with a job_id to poll at photalabs.jobs.get.
client_request_id is an idempotency key: a retried submit with the same value returns the original job instead of charging again.

endpoints.name: Generate images from a prompt
endpoints.summary: Images from text, with identity preserved for profiles referenced as [[profile_id]].

prompt.description: What to generate; reference people as [[profile_id]].
prompt.example: [[abc123]] hiking at golden hour, candid photo

aspect_ratio.description: Defaults to the model's default (4:3 when auto is unsupported).

quality.description: GPT Image models only: auto, low, medium, high (xhigh, max on GPT Image 2.5).

response_mode.description: bytes (default, base64) or urls (signed URLs, 24-hour expiry).

async.description: true returns 202 with a job_id; requires response_mode urls.

notes: A read over POST billed per output image (see pricing).

endpoints.name: Edit photos from a prompt
endpoints.summary: Edits input images per a text prompt, preserving the identity of listed profiles.

prompt.description: The edit to make; reference people as [[profile_id]].

images.description: Input images as public URLs or raw base64 (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC); over 4096 px is resized.

profile_ids.description: Candidate profiles of the person in the photo; pass only that end-user's profiles.

base_model.description: Underlying image model; default nb2 (see photalabs.image.generate for the list).

async.description: true returns 202 with a job_id; requires response_mode urls.

notes: A read over POST billed per output image.

endpoints.name: Enhance a photo
endpoints.summary: Automatic enhancement of one image, optionally guided by a prompt and identity profiles.

image.description: Input image as a public URL or raw base64.

async.description: true returns 202 with a job_id; requires response_mode urls.

notes: A read over POST; $0.12 per output image, $0.15 with identity.

endpoints.name: Get an async job's status
endpoints.summary: Status and, when finished, result URLs of an async edit, generate, enhance or remix job.
notes: Polling is authoritative; callbacks are best-effort.

endpoints.name: List profile ids
endpoints.summary: Profile ids on the account, optionally filtered by tag.

endpoints.name: Get a profile's training status
endpoints.summary: Whether a profile has finished training.

endpoints.name: Create and train a profile
endpoints.summary: Starts training an identity profile from photo URLs; returns the profile id at once.

image_urls.description: Public URLs of photos of one person: 10-50 for standard, 5-10 for fast training.

training_tier.description: standard (default, Full Train) or fast (Quick Train).

tag.description: Immutable tag to group the profile, e.g. your end-user's id.

model_version.description: v1 or v2; the account default (v2 for new accounts) when omitted.

notes: Charges $2.90 per profile (Full Train) or $1.49 (Quick Train). Poll photalabs.profiles.status until training completes.
